sql: SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-15', DATE '2024-01-07', WEEK) AS v
SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-01-10', WEEK) AS STRING) AS v
SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-01-10', WEEK(MONDAY)) AS STRING) AS v
note: transpiles to invalid DuckDB DATE_TRUNC(WEEK(MONDAY), ...) -> BinderException

sql: SELECT CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(1, 0) AS STRING) AS v
SELECT IFNULL(CAST(NULL AS INT64), -1) AS v
SELECT COUNTIF(x > 1) AS v FROM UNNEST([1, 2, NULL, 3]) AS x
SELECT CAST(7 / 2 AS STRING) AS v
SELECT CAST(ROUND(2.5) AS STRING) AS a, CAST(ROUND(-2.5) AS STRING) AS b
SELECT CAST(ROUND(CAST(2.5 AS NUMERIC)) AS STRING) AS v
SELECT STRING_AGG(s, ',' ORDER BY s) AS v FROM UNNEST(['b','a',CAST(NULL AS STRING),'c']) AS s
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(CAST(x AS STRING) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY x), ',') AS v FROM UNNEST([3,1,NULL,2]) AS x
SELECT v FROM UNNEST([1,1,2,3]) AS v QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY v) <= 1 ORDER BY v
SELECT e, off FROM UNNEST(['x','y','z']) AS e WITH OFFSET AS off ORDER BY off
note: WITH OFFSET is 0-based; transpiled WITH ORDINALITY is 1-based -> off-by-one

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 23:30:00+00' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS v
SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2024-01-01 12:34:56' AS STRING) AS v
